requirements.title: Voice-over Tone and Energy
requirements.definition: The voice-over should use the requested energetic, lively, inspiring, and subtly proud delivery without sounding overacted.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers expressive tone and energy only. Pacing is separate because the client considered one take's pauses preferable while independently requesting more energy and liveliness.

requirements.title: Voice-over Pacing and Smoothness
requirements.definition: The voice-over should use suitable pauses and smooth phrasing, particularly in the final sentence.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from tone and energy because message 2 evaluates pauses positively while requesting a different change to energy, and message 9 independently identifies excessive pauses in the final sentence.

requirements.title: Alternate Voice-over Takes
requirements.definition: Provide multiple distinct voice-over takes so the client can compare delivery directions and select a preferred version.
requirements.boundary_note: The alternate recordings are an independently requested review deliverable, not merely execution evidence about one performance attribute.

requirements.title: Edited Selected Voice-over Takes
requirements.definition: Edit each voice-over take selected by the client for management review.

requirements.title: Separate Audio File Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the selected edited voice-over takes as separate audio files.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello dear,

I truly apologize for the delay, I had an emergency and had to take a few days off. Thank you for your patience and for sending over multiple takes; I really appreciate your effort.

After reviewing them, I feel that **Take Two** is better than the others especially in terms of pauses, but we'd love to try another version that brings even more energy and liveliness to the delivery.

We actually have an AI-generated sample that I'm sharing now, just as a reference for the tone and energy we’re aiming for. Of course, your vibrant voice will bring it to life far better!

I understand there’s a time difference, but please let me know when you’re available to record today, so I’ll make sure to be online and responsive.

Best regards!

value_updates.energy_and_liveliness: More energy and liveliness than the reviewed takes
